name: recourse-engine
description: Recourse: the deterministic engine behind `recourse analyze`. Captures and hashes institutional policy sources, resolves which one governs a decision, compiles only rules it can verify verbatim (with a fail-closed deontic-support gate), replays a case's append-only event trace against them, checks procedural conformance including stated waivers, forecasts at explicit future instants, and emits a Recourse Trace. No LLM call anywhere in this package.
